tagline.en_US: Capture email sent by local applications and inspect messages in a simple browser-based inbox.

description.en_US: Mailpit is an email testing tool and API designed for developers. It acts as an SMTP server to capture outgoing emails from local applications and provides a web interface to view and inspect them. The tool also provides a REST API for automated integration testing, along with features to check HTML compatibility, validate links, and evaluate spam scoring.
